structural_variants.otherCytogenetics: 6q21/6q23: 91% of cells were missing both signals for 6q probes (6q21 and MYB at 6q23) but had two signals for the centromere, consistent with deletion due to dic(6;7) formation. | Chromosome 20: 35.5% of cells had an extra signal for both probes, consistent with trisomy 20. | IGH (14q32): 30.5% of cells had an extra intact signal, consistent with trisomy 14.
